name: ratemycode
description: Audits AI-built and vibe-coded apps for release risk, including cross-document fact drift, then optionally records authorized fixes and independent retests in a durable audit ledger.

interface.longDescription: RateMyCode audits a real AI-built product, not just its code style. It first confirms one coherent product target from linked artifacts such as a repository, deployment, evidence, and documentation. Then choose a product lead, hostile user, Staff engineer, skeptical VC, or oral-defense professor and how hard to judge it. The plugin tests real flows when possible, compares overlapping facts across internal docs, llms.txt, schemas, examples, UI copy, and live docs, traces failures into the implementation, blocks unsafe launches, and returns every finding in plain language. When explicitly authorized, it records scoped fixes, new release identities, independent retests, and remaining risk in a durable JSON audit ledger with a generated Markdown report.
defaultPrompt: As a Staff engineer, audit this app for a public launch: list every issue and name the three to fix first.
As a hostile user, strictly test signup, checkout, recovery, and cancellation.
As a skeptical VC, separate product evidence from founder claims and name the cheapest next test.
